text:
maria: quick heads-up — noticed a ~30% throughput regression on the AWQ weight-only INT8 path after yesterday's packer alignment change. rolling smoke tests against gpt-medium-8k show a big spike in pack-time.

cheng: ugh, saw the perf alert from perf-bot. can you paste the perf numbers and a tiny repro?

perf-bot: [alert] regression detected: awq_int8_weightonly/full_stack @ us-east-1 — baseline=120.3k tok/s, current=84.7k tok/s, p=0.002. trace: https://internal.perf/reports/2765432100

maria: repro is simple microbench hitting the dedicated runtime with tokens=512, batch=8, seq=1024 distribution. baseline (before packer change) run:
```
# before
tokens/sec: 120300
pack-ms: 1.18
kernel-exec-ms: 2.4
kv-prefetch-ms: 0.35
```
after patch:
```
# after
tokens/sec: 84700
pack-ms: 3.82  # big jump
kernel-exec-ms: 2.1
kv-prefetch-ms: 1.1   # more cache churn
```

eli: pack-ms increase is suspicious. did alignment add per-group padding or extra memcpy?

maria: yes — new packer aligns groups to 64-byte lanes for AVX2/AVX512 friendly layout. it introduced an extra stage that materializes an intermediate buffer when group_size % lane != 0. on these models group_size=17 (AWQ small gs), so we hit the spill path.

sam: so small group sizes (17, 32) cause the packer to do scalar fallbacks? can kernel chooser be detecting incompatible layout and falling back to slower path?

cheng: i dug into the kernel chooser: it picks vectorized kernel only when (group_size % pack_lane == 0) and is_aligned(buffer). otherwise it selects the generic scalar kernel which expects unpacked layout and triggers memcpy to realign. packer change made more tensors fail the aligned check.

maria: exactly. two buckets of cost here: extra memcpy in pack stage + scalar kernel that is less throughput-friendly. also KV prefetch pattern changed: packer now interleaves channels differently which increases working set, causing L2 misses and kv-cache prefetch to wake more often (hence kv-prefetch-ms spike).

eli: do we have perf traces to show L1/L2 miss delta?

maria: yes — perf trace attached to the report shows ~2.6x L2 miss increase on the hot matmul loops. snippet:
```
perf stat summary:
L1-dcache-load-misses: +8%
LLC-load-misses: +160%
cycles: +18%
```

cheng: interesting that kernel-exec-ms went down slightly (2.4 -> 2.1). probably because scalar kernel has smaller steady-state latency per micro-op but terrible throughput under batching. pack overhead dominates for small batches.

sam: any quick mitigations? revert packer change? tweak group_size? kernel chooser relax?

maria: short-term: revert the packer change for the INT8 weight-only path (we can gate behind feature flag). medium-term: two options we discussed: 1) modify packer to avoid intermediate materialize when group_size < pack_lane by doing in-place partial interleave; 2) change kernel chooser to allow vectorized kernels even when misaligned by emitting masked/vector tail loops (requires AVX masked support and some microkernel work).

eli: also consider dynamic group_size override during calibration. calibration step for AWQ set group_size=17 because of quant quality tradeoffs; for serving we could pad to nearest compatible group but store meta that indicates effective group_size for dequant path. need to measure quality delta though.

maria: did a quick, cheap quality test — pad group to 32 for weights-only and ran eval on core prompt-set (1k prompts): mean rouge-like metric drop ~0.3% absolute (within our regression tolerance for some customers) but some corner-cases have larger delta. need more systematic eval.

cheng: prioritized action items:
- revert packer alignment change on canary for INT8 weight-only (maria) — blocks immediate rollback.
- add unit to packer to detect small group_size and use in-place partial interleave (sam/eli) — target PR in 3d.
- add perf test to CI that runs AWQ-int8 microbench with gs in {16,17,32} and asserts pack-ms < 2ms (cheng).
- run calibration+eval set comparing pad->32 vs original 17 for quality guardrails (maria + research).

sam: i'll start a draft PR to gate the alignment behind config flag and push to canary tomorrow morning.

maria: thanks. leaving notes in the perf ticket with the reproduction commands:
```
LD_PRELOAD=... ./microbench --model gpt-medium-8k --quant awq --group-size 17 --batch 8 --seq 1024 --measure pack,kernel,kv
```

maria: pinging @cheng as owner for kernel chooser follow-ups. i'll attach pprof and flamegraphs to the ticket. :mag: :construction:
